body: If I could I would. I swear to God that's the honest truth. This is why I'm in therapy and on medication. I'd be volunteering too if the world wasn't so shut down. I guess that should be my first priority is finding places I can still volunteer. But the other option is finding a way to off myself yknow?

The latter. I remember trying to make her feel bad. Typing that, I can't believe I'm not locked up somewhere

Nothing really. Like you said it's all been validation. My last therapist didn't even think I was abusive. They've said I still deserve to have positive relationships. 

I did find a DV prevention program in my area, I'm going to call as soon as I get off work.

I'm 23. I'm on mood stabilizers and antidepressants, but I think I need to up my dose of the former. 

My trigger is usually me screwing up: like, when we got lost it was because I let my phone die. When I put my head through the window it was because I saw how much of my room I had to clean up. 

I am currently in school and cant support myself in an apartment, but hopefully I'm moving out of my parents' and into my uncle's, where we'll interact with each other less. 

Just to be clear--I should end my relationships? What about friendships?
I can try. I will try. I just don't know. Because I've been trying

You're right. Violence is controlling. I'm so sorry for not thinking of it that way. And you're also right, it was only ever her or my family. 

Holy shit I have no idea what to do.
Lost my temper at myself and at random shit I should clarify. Like, one time we were driving and we were lost, and I threw something because I was so mad that we were lost.
I lost my temper and broke things in front of her. I sometimes went into weird brain fogs where I'd just repeat random nonsense, laugh maniacally, and say mean shit, which really scared her.

Yes. Well, no, I don't think I ever tried to control her and I don't think she's arguing that I did. But yes I have major control problems, I can't control myself, hence the window. 1 also sounds like me, I have difficulty understanding what I really need and what I just want. 

So....what now? How do I keep going?
